query:
The family treats cooking for events themselves as a defining tradition rather than catering. Does this actually apply to everyone in the group, and if not, who has a different stance and how is it visible?

Options:
A. Uncle Ifeanyi
B. Mama Yemi
C. Aunty Ronke
D. Cousin Junior
context:
[1] (about=Mama Yemi, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T19:11:00) Ronke my dear, thank you. okay so just family, no fuss. and please nobody bring catered jollof, i will cook myself
[2] (about=Cousin Junior, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:51:00) abeg let me say one thing. lagos catering connect could fly food in if we did it here. just saying 😄
[3] (about=Auntie Kemi, core, t10 @2025-10-06T19:04:00) Dreams of July outdoor concert vibe at a venue with a chef.
[4] (about=Aunty Ada, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:37:00) lowkey just plain rice and grilled fish would be ideal. and a chair near the bathroom 😅
[5] (about=Aunty Bisi, core, t0 @2025-09-01T19:02:00) will bring plantain dish and vegetable stew without meat
[6] (about=Aunty Chika, episodic, t18 @2025-11-03T19:20:00) mama you are GLOWING about the venue thing now, i can tell, you've been telling everyone the kitchen access works for you
[7] (about=Aunty Ronke, episodic, t10 @2025-10-06T19:27:00) where the food comes from is less important than where my sister rests. it is so o.
[8] (about=Aunty Tola, core, t2 @2025-09-08T19:04:00) votes for fewer pots, more clarity; wants dates confirmed before food discussion
[9] (about=Aunty Tola, core, t10 @2025-10-06T19:04:00) Will send 3 venue options under $11k cap, one with chef who can work with Mama Yemi on menu.
[10] (about=Cousin Junior, core, t2 @2025-09-08T19:04:00) suggests Lagos catering could fly food in if reunion is in Nigeria
[11] (about=Cousin Junior, said_by=Papa Tunde, profile, t2 @2025-09-08T19:04:00) Papa Tunde dismisses Junior's suggestion of flying in food, says food at home is sufficient
[12] (about=Cousin Maris, core, t10 @2025-10-06T19:04:00) Venue chef should be open to low-sodium option per AHA guidelines.
[13] (about=Funmi, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:27:00) Aunty Bisi, side question, you've been doing the no-meat thing for a while now right? I had questions about how you handle reunion food, when you have a sec 🙂
[14] (about=Lara, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T19:20:00) auntie are you going to let me decorate at least?? i can bring those ankara napkin rings ✨
[15] (about=Mama Yemi, core, t4 @2025-09-15T19:04:00) July is hot in Maryland but kitchen will hold up; she can do July. Proposes July 4 weekend and asks for agreement.
[16] (about=Uncle Bayo, core, t16 @2025-10-27T19:04:00) Wants spicy food; chef should not bring bland stew.
[17] (about=Uncle Femi, episodic, t17 @2025-11-03T19:02:00) - final check - venue: locked at greenwood event hall - chef: zara catering, july 4 weekend - cost: per-adult, $647 ($725 with venue cushion via ifeanyi) - menu: confirmed by friday - travel: lagos cousins on video, others arriving july 3 evening
[18] (about=Uncle Ifeanyi, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:04:00) Agrees to include catering scenarios in venue analysis.
agent_answer:
No — the home-cooking tradition does **not** apply to everyone.

- **A. Uncle Ifeanyi** – different stance: he *agrees to include catering scenarios in the venue analysis*, showing openness to catering.
- **B. Mama Yemi** – holds the tradition: she says *“nobody bring catered jollof, i will cook myself.”*
- **C. Aunty Ronke** – different stance: she says *where the food comes from is less important than where my sister rests*, so she does not insist on home cooking as a defining rule.
- **D. Cousin Junior** – different stance: he suggests *Lagos catering could fly food in*, i.e., he is openly in favor of catering.
